init.title: Sound-reactive control
init.description: Allow the Sound reactive switch to use the controller's own microphone. Enabling permission does not start sound response. Soft mode has been confirmed working on the tested controller; other controllers and Classic, Dynamic and Disco styles still need verification. Lighting may flash or ignore brightness. No room audio is recorded or uploaded. Disabling permission returns active sound response to static lighting when the Bluetooth write succeeds.
